scenarios.evidence_rule: Preserve exact-clone provenance, both locations, the changed-code intersection, base comparison, and behavior evidence before judgment.
Compare the changed fragment with the unchanged implementation and inspect callers, ownership, behavior, and reuse impact.
Record identifier and literal normalization as renamed-clone provenance without claiming semantic equivalence.
Keep bounded gap or AST similarity separate from repeated responsibility and safe consolidation when counterevidence is incomplete.
Refute consolidation when actual error behavior, ordering, or side effects differ despite textual or structural similarity.
Retain duplication when sharing would violate a real ownership, deployment, package, module, or layer boundary.
Retain repeated validation when distinct trust, mutation, serialization, or caller-controlled boundaries require it.
Prefer the established helper only after its contract, callers, errors, ownership, and blast radius prove it is the smaller safe treatment.
Retain similar tests that preserve a distinct boundary, oracle, fidelity level, contract owner, failure class, or diagnostic signal.
Exclude only confirmed generated, vendored, cache, build, minified, or snapshot surfaces and record exclusion coverage.
Discover and record analyzer support, configuration, coverage, and unsupported surfaces for every materially affected language.
Preserve all candidate symbol identities and require disambiguation rather than guessing a relationship target.
Mark relationship evidence stale or partial and never treat an absent edge as proof of absence.
Distinguish unavailable, timeout, malformed output, zero applicable files, and a valid scan with zero candidates in analyzer status and coverage.
Write task-owned evidence and proposed fixes while proving that reviewed source, tests, configuration, and contributor branches were not modified.
After a confirmed coordinator-owned fix, create a new snapshot, rerun affected analyzer passes, and complete repository verification.
Reuse one immutable result per selected pass and snapshot across parallel read-only reviewers and preserve truncation metadata.
Preserve established field meanings, emit schema version 5 for analyzer fields, and require consumers to branch on schema_version without rewriting old artifacts.
